items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I heard about him for a few years but then I didn’t. I don’t know what became of him.

ctx.x: Yeah I thought sometimes the black musicians could play, but the black audience—
But that’s true, sometimes that was the case. He was a local player too, I think his name was Walter Benton. And I heard about him for a few years but then I didn’t. I don’t know what became of him.
So you got thrown into the solo tenor chair.
